samples.cypher:
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(t) AS incoming_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(t) AS incoming_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) RETURN count(r) AS incoming_transfers, sum(r.amount) AS total_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE b.id <> a.id
RETURN count(DISTINCT b) AS reachable_accounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(r:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE r <> a
RETURN count(DISTINCT r) AS reachable_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE b <> a
RETURN count(DISTINCT b) AS reachableCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(a) WHERE owner._workspace_id = $workspace_id
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(acct:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN owner.id AS ownerId, count(acct) AS totalAccounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a.acct_no = $acct_no
MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(acct:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN owner.id AS owner_id, count(DISTINCT acct) AS total_accounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH owner
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(acct:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN owner.id AS owner_id, count(acct) AS total_accounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN dst.acct_no AS counterparty
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})- [t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN dst.acct_no AS counterparty, t AS transfer
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:INVEST]->(c:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:INVEST]->(c:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a.owner_id = c.id
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS person_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:INVEST]->(c:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a.owner_id = c.id
RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS person_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, acctCount
UNION
MATCH (owner:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, acctCount
ORDER BY acctCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

CALL {
  MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
  WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
  RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, owner.id AS ownerId, acctCount
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (owner:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
  WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
  RETURN owner.name AS ownerName, owner.id AS ownerId, acctCount
}
RETURN ownerName, ownerId, acctCount
ORDER BY acctCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
RETURN owner.id AS ownerId, owner.name AS ownerName, acctCount AS accountCount
UNION ALL
MATCH (owner:Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH owner, count(a) AS acctCount
WHERE acctCount >= $min_accounts
RETURN owner.id AS ownerId, owner.name AS ownerName, acctCount AS accountCount
ORDER BY accountCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(b {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(c {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN count(*) AS chainCount, count(DISTINCT a) AS distinctStarters LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p1:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(p2:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(p3:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WITH count(*) AS chainCount, count(DISTINCT p1) AS distinctStarters RETURN chainCount, distinctStarters LIMIT $limit

MATCH (p1:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(p2:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:GUARANTEE]->(p3:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH count(*) AS chainCount, count(DISTINCT p1) AS startCount
RETURN chainCount, startCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:TRANSFER]->(t {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN c.code AS channel, count(t) AS tx_count
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN c.code AS channel, count(*) AS tx_count LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN c.code AS channel, count(*) AS tx_count LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE c.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(t) AS transferCount, sum(t.amount) AS totalAmount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (src)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(r) AS transferCount, sum(r.amount) AS totalAmount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (src)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= $risk_weight
RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (s:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(r:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no}) WITH s, count(*) AS cnt WHERE cnt >= $min_count RETURN s.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, cnt AS transfer_count ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT $limit

MATCH (t:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
MATCH (s:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(t)
WITH s, count(*) AS transfers
WHERE transfers >= $min_count
RETURN s.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, transfers
ORDER BY transfers DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH sender, count(*) AS transfers
WHERE transfers >= $min_count
RETURN sender.acct_no AS sender_acct_no, transfers
ORDER BY sender_acct_no
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE dst.acct_no = $acct_no AND t.amount < $amount_max
RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [r:TRANSFER]-> (tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WHERE r.amount <= $amount_max
RETURN count(r) AS transferCount, sum(r.amount) AS totalAmount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) WHERE dst.acct_no = $acct_no AND t.amount < $amount_max RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount LIMIT $limit

CALL {
  MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(a_start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  MATCH (a_start)-[:TRANSFER]->(a_target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  WHERE a_target.acct_no = $acct_no
  RETURN l
  UNION
  MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(a_start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  MATCH (a_start)-[:TRANSFER]->(:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(a_target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  WHERE a_target.acct_no = $acct_no
  RETURN l
  UNION
  MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(a_start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  MATCH (a_start)-[:TRANSFER]->(:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(a_target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
  WHERE a_target.acct_no = $acct_no
  RETURN l
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS loanCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER*1..3]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
WITH count(DISTINCT l) AS loanCount
RETURN loanCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (loan:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:DEPOSIT]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER*1..3]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $acct_no})
RETURN count(DISTINCT loan) AS loan_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (l)-[r:REPAY {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}]->(p {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH l, coalesce(sum(r.amount), 0) AS total_repaid
WHERE total_repaid < $repaid_ratio * l.principal
RETURN l.id AS loan_id, l.principal, total_repaid
ORDER BY l.id
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (l:Loan {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [r:REPAY]->(l)
WITH l, sum(r.amount) AS total_repaid
WHERE total_repaid < $repaid_ratio * l.principal
RETURN l.id AS loan_id, l.principal, total_repaid
LIMIT $limit
